dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes maintenance, quarries, stockpile, borrow , and gravel pits used by Transportation Division. Other pits and quarries not used by Transportation Division are also included. Pit features where the source is "records" may have a poor position accuracy.

Distributed from [GeoYukon](https://yukon.ca/geoyukon) by the [Government of Yukon](https://yukon.ca/maps) . Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.



For more information: [geomatics.help@yukon.ca](mailto:geomatics.help@yukon.ca)
